targetOwners.responsibility: After settlement and claim acquisition, own the bounded improvement of the existing Workspace Agent Operations Plugin.
Remain the read-only capability-selection dependency; this successor does not modify its common provider-neutral contract.

installedObservation.observationMethod: version-matched owner guide and command help

supportedMappings.requiredEvidence: A provider effect receipt followed by a UI inventory or UI receipt read-back.
A provider effect receipt followed by visual-layout inventory when pane topology matters.
A provider effect receipt or UI receipt that identifies the focused surface without persisting a runtime handle.

unsupportedMapping.fallback: Preserve the current layout, accept provider-default split geometry, record 65/35 only as unapplied intent, use short titles and explicit switching for readability, and continue only when the exact layout is non-mandatory; otherwise hold for a different admitted surface.
prohibitedFallbacks: Do not type resize instructions into a terminal and treat the text as control.
Do not invent a CLI flag or infer success from visible terminal output.
Do not create another worker, session, reusable Agent, Component, or supervised Run to compensate.

minimalPluginContract: A generic Loop Architecture conformance cue loads the visibility plan only and cannot mutate UI state.
Every mutation binds the exact session scope, expected current topology revision, named UI-effect owner, requested effect, least-capability and effect-admission evidence, and postcondition read-back.
The task-local projection permits at most three visible task panes and preserves unrelated visible groups.
A terminal title uses a sanitized ordinal, role, and short objective within the provider profile's 32-character budget and contains no authority claim.
Create and rename do not steal focus; switching requires the named UI-effect owner and an exact current target.
Each session exposes at most one 96-character summary line containing role, short objective, and normalized stage or blocker.
Rename, split, and switch require provider receipts plus the exact postcondition read-back stated for each mapping.
Resize, move, merge, and numeric ratio mutation are explicitly unsupported by Orca CLI 1.4.206.
observationControlBoundary: Terminal content is not the UI control plane.
A send receipt proves only the stage stated by that receipt and does not prove UI mutation, a started turn, acknowledgement, or semantic alignment.
UI inventory or an exact UI effect receipt may establish visibility or layout observation; it does not establish work completion.
Provider commands and runtime locators remain adapter-private and must not enter tracked source, human handoff prose, or portable receipts.
reuseAndNoDuplication: Route this handoff only to the already existing task-local coordinator or session-control successor after its scoped ownership settles.
Consume the exact preflight evidence recorded above; do not start or repeat a preflight.
Do not create a new reusable Agent or Loop Architecture Component for this mapping.
Do not use the deprecated Orca-orchestration dependency as the common communication mechanism.
expectedSuccessorEvidence: The Workspace Agent Operations profile declares the three supported mappings and the ratio fallback for the installed version.
The Plugin uses existing Tool Capability Resolution without changing it or converting availability into permission.
Focused checks demonstrate observation and control separation and reject terminal text as control evidence.
No raw prompt, transcript, runtime handle, or provider-private payload appears in tracked source.
